_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/attachments/test_aura_host_restriction.py. t_ah_retether is Retether as the coordinator authors it: return_from_graveyard with aura_host {types: [Creature]}. t_ah_any_aura is 'Enchant permanent' and nothing else, the clause broad enough that the arrival's filter is what keeps it off a land or an artifact.

cards.name: Test Retether
cards.oracle_text: Return each Aura card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Only creatures can be enchanted this way. (Aura cards that can't enchant a creature on the battlefield remain in your graveyard.)
